title.zh: US crypto ETFs draw over $3 billion this week, with nearly $800 million flowing beyond Bitcoin
title.en: US crypto ETFs draw over $3 billion this week, with nearly $800 million flowing beyond Bitcoin

current_state.zh: US spot crypto ETFs pulled in roughly $3.04 billion in net inflows from Monday through Thursday, with $2.25 billion into Bitcoin and nearly $793 million flowing into Ethereum, Solana, XRP and Zcash products.
